jobs.description:
Enterprise IT & Quality

Ballerup, Denmark

Your impact begins here

Cyber resilience is becoming one of the most important capabilities for organisations operating in an increasingly connected world. As Programme Director, Cyber Resilience, you will lead a critical enterprise-wide programme that helps strengthen resilience across Novo Nordisk while supporting safe and efficient business operations.

Working on behalf of the Deputy CISO, you will provide leadership across a network of senior stakeholders, workstream leads and subject matter experts. This is a role where success comes through influence, governance and the ability to create alignment across organisational boundaries rather than through direct line management. You will help translate strategic ambitions into coordinated action, ensuring the programme delivers meaningful business outcomes while remaining connected to enterprise priorities.

What you'll bring

You are an experienced enterprise programme leader who thrives in complex environments and knows how to mobilise leaders around a shared vision. You bring the confidence to challenge constructively, navigate competing priorities and create momentum across large, matrixed organisations.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A master's degree or equivalent professional experience within programme management, technology, cyber security, business, engineering or a related field.

• Significant experience leading complex enterprise-wide programmes, transformations, PMO initiatives or technology-focused programmes.

• Strong expertise in programme governance, integrated planning, risk management, dependency management, portfolio reporting and resource planning.

• Experience creating alignment across senior leaders, programme leads, technical experts and business stakeholders in large organisations.

• The ability to lead through influence, stakeholder engagement and governance forums rather than formal people management authority.

• Strong understanding of cyber resilience, operational risk or technology risk, combined with excellent communication, facilitation and influencing skills and fluency in English.

What you'll do

As Programme Director, Cyber Resilience, you will create the structure, governance and leadership needed to drive a strategic programme across multiple functions and business areas.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the end-to-end Cyber Resilience Programme, including scope, roadmap, milestones, resources, benefits, dependencies and delivery outcomes.

• Establishing and maintaining effective programme governance, reporting structures and decision-making forums that support transparency and accountability.

• Aligning cyber security priorities with Line of Business needs, balancing risk management requirements with practical business realities.

• Providing direction and coordination across multiple workstream leaders, ensuring integrated planning and clear ownership of deliverables

• Managing programme risks, interdependencies and escalations while supporting timely decision-making across stakeholder groups.

• Acting as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by translating complex cyber resilience topics into clear choices, actions, progress updates and business implications.

Who you'll work with

You will join the Enterprise IT & Quality organisation and work closely with the Information Security organisation while partnering with stakeholders across the value chain. The programme sits at the intersection of cyber risk, technology and business operations, creating broad exposure across the enterprise.

This role requires strong leadership in a highly matrixed environment. You will collaborate with senior business leaders, programme leads, cyber security specialists and technology teams across multiple functions and geographies. Success will depend on your ability to build trusted relationships, create alignment between diverse perspectives and drive progress through partnership and influence rather than direct line management.

What you can expect here

This is an opportunity to shape a strategically important programme at enterprise scale while working alongside colleagues who are passionate about creating lasting impact. You will have the chance to influence senior decision-making, strengthen resilience across the organisation and contribute to solutions that support the future of the business. At Novo Nordisk, you will join an environment that encourages learning, collaboration and continuous development, helping you grow while making a meaningful contribution.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800 to 1,448,700 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here: https://www.novonordisk.com/careers/working-at-novo-nordisk/total-rewards-benefits.html.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead an enterprise-wide cyber resilience programme and create alignment across senior stakeholders, programme leaders and business functions, we encourage you to apply for the Programme Director, Cyber Resilience role in Ballerup, Denmark.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.1. November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Global Assoc Commercial Competitive Intelligence Director
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Global Associate Commercial Competitive Intelligence Director, you will help shape the strategies behind Novo’s projects and future commercial brands in diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease. You will monitor the commercial competitive landscape, competitor strategies and turn what you find into data-driven insights that sharpen decisions at project, product and portfolio level. By elevating and challenging our approach, you will help Novo stay ahead – and strengthen the commercial strategies that bring treatments to people living with diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease.

What you’ll bring

You think independently, set the agenda before you are asked and bring people together across functions to influence decisions. You are comfortable in an expert role and confident managing stakeholders at every level. We are open to candidates at different career stages, so the depth of experience we look for will vary with your background:

• An M.Sc. in Business, Medicine or Life/Pharmaceutical Sciences.

• Relevant experience in similar roles.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical industry is highly preferred.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable intelligence.

• The ability – or a proven track record – to communicate scientific, medical and commercial information clearly to diverse audiences, including senior management.

• An understanding of drug development, commercial strategy and pharmaceutical value chains, with depth matching your seniority.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience in social media monitoring.

What you’ll do

You will provide high-quality monitoring and insight generation on the commercial competitive landscape and competitor strategies, helping commercial teams act on what is happening in the market today.

• Deliver high-quality, data-driven insights on the commercial competitive landscape across diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease.

• Drive strong commercial competitive insights that improve decision-making at project, product and portfolio level.

• Lead assessments of key intelligence topics of strategic interest, working with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Act as a strategic partner to Commercial teams, making sure real-time insights are translated into competitive counter-strategies.

• Contribute to building and developing the Commercial Competitive Intelligence function.

• Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across the organisation.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Commercial Competitive Intelligence team, which monitors, assesses and activates commercial competitive intelligence within core strategic areas in diabetes, obesity, Liver and CVD. The team is part of Strategic Insights, where you will work alongside colleagues in Customer & Consumer Insights and in Data, Analytics & AI Strategy.

Strategic Insights sits within Product & Portfolio Strategy, which drives commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across all therapy areas. The area acts as a connector and compass – guiding the portfolio for sustained competitiveness upstream and maximising its potential through strong commercial strategies and competitive launches downstream.

Your closest partners will be Commercial teams, and you will engage with stakeholders across the value chain. Bringing these perspectives together – and creating clarity on what competitor moves mean for Novo – is how your insights will turn into action.

What you can expect here

You will take on an expert role with real influence: your insights will feed directly into decisions on projects, products and the wider portfolio. You will be trusted to set the agenda, make your voice heard and challenge established thinking when the evidence calls for it.

You will also help develop the Commercial Competitive Intelligence function itself, giving you the chance to shape how the work is done, not just deliver it. Working across commercial, medical and data-focused colleagues, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job. Because we are open to different career stages, your responsibilities and salary will be tailored to your experience.

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn competitive intelligence into decisions that keep Novo ahead in diabetes and obesity, apply for the Global Assoc Competitive Intelligence Director role by 29 October 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The brain

The agents are the arms. The next layer is a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers: conversations on chat, email, phone and social, on-site behaviour, orders, returns and reviews.

The system identifies the moments where a sale is won or lost and intervenes while the session is still live. It scores answer coverage per product and closes the gaps, quantifies objections and unmet demand, and traces returns back to the expectation that broke.

Learning happens across all webshops, more than six million visits a month, where patterns become visible that no single shop has the traffic to see. Every intervention is measured against a control group. The patterns are shared, the data stays with each shop.

The hard problems are retrieval and evaluation of LLM output at scale, data isolation when patterns are shared across customers, latency in real-time flows, and attribution that holds up under scrutiny.

The stack

Java with Spring Boot, React and MongoDB, with language models and vector search on top. Moving the backend to C# and .NET is under consideration.

The role

Technical ownership of the platform: architecture, code quality, operations, security and prioritisation, combined with hands-on development every day. Standards for review, testing, monitoring and releases, and recruiting the next developers.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished tech organisation with fixed processes. The standards for review, testing, operations and releases, and the developers you hire, become the foundation the platform and the team grow on.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• 
Several years of designing and running SaaS systems in production, with ownership of architecture and uptime

• 
Solid backend experience in Java or C#, plus React

• 
LLM-based features shipped to production, with systematic evaluation and improvement

• 
Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and incident handling

• 
AI-assisted development as part of the daily workflow

The person

• 
Dreams of owning and building a company

• 
Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• 
Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• 
Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• 
Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• 
Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• 
Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

What we offer

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Equity

Short decision paths and a high degree of technical freedom

Office at Storms Pakhus in Odense

jobs.occupation: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks
Battery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies 
We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

We offer:

Welcome to MASCOT

At MASCOT, we are more than a family-owned international growth company – we are a workplace where ambition, passion, and collaboration go hand in hand. Our ambition is simple: to develop, manufacture, market, and sell the world's best workwear and safety footwear.

Would you like to help create the solutions of tomorrow and become part of a company where quality is at the heart of everything we do? Then MASCOT is the place for you.

(Please send your resume in English)

jobs.occupation: PhD in Quantum Computing for Power Systems
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from December 1, 2026, or as soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks
This PhD position focuses on the application of quantum computing to computational challenges in power systems with high shares of renewable energy. You will investigate quantum and hybrid quantum–classical methods for power system analysis and optimization, with emphasis on their practical performance and suitability for real-time applications.

Your work will include formulating representative power system analysis and optimization problems, developing and implementing quantum and hybrid quantum–classical solution methods, and comparing their performance with relevant classical approaches. You will also evaluate the developed methods through numerical studies and real-time power system simulation. The research will involve scientific programming, analysis and documentation of results, and dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and international conferences.

The position is offered within the Center for Research on Microgrids, and the PhD student will be affiliated with the Electric Power Systems and Microgrids section at AAU Energy.

Your competencies 
The applicant must have a relevant educational background in electrical engineering, energy engineering, computer science, or a closely related field. You should have a solid foundation in mathematical modelling and numerical methods, together with experience in scientific programming, preferably in Python. Knowledge of power system analysis and optimization (e.g., power flow and optimal power flow), as well as experience with quantum computing methods and algorithms (e.g., HHL or variational quantum linear solvers for linear system problems, and QAOA or quantum annealing for optimization problems), is expected.

Experience with real-time power system simulation using platforms such as RTDS or OPAL-RT would be an advantage. Previous peer-reviewed journal publications at the intersection of quantum computing and power and energy systems would also be considered an advantage. You should be motivated to further develop your expertise across both power systems and quantum computing.

You should be able to organize and conduct research independently, document and communicate your methods and results clearly, and discuss technical challenges constructively with colleagues. The position requires both independent research and collaboration with researchers from different disciplinary backgrounds, as well as good written and spoken English.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Role and impact:

As Principal Cost Estimator, you will play a pivotal role in preparing competitive cost estimates for Topsoe’s proprietary hardware and total installed costs for proposals and studies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including licensing, business development, proposal management, project teams, product management, and process and mechanical engineering—to provide expert cost-estimation advice that supports strategic management decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparing cost estimates for proprietary hardware and total installed costs for proposals and studies

• 
Contributing to early-study and Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) cost estimates

• 
Understanding the scope, contract, schedule, project execution approach, local conditions, construction execution, and financing assumptions relevant to each proposal

• 
Planning estimate methodologies that meet customer expectations

• 
Reviewing and benchmarking estimates using experience data and checking estimate quality

• 
Developing cost-estimation tools, methods, processes, and products

• 
Supporting standardization and effective execution of Topsoe technology solutions

• 
Presenting cost information to management to support decision-making

• 
Coordinating cost reviews with internal departments and, where relevant, customers and other teams

Your work will have a direct impact on the competitiveness and quality of Topsoe’s proposals and project delivery. You will also drive improvements in standardization and execution of Topsoe technology solutions, ensuring all estimates are well-founded, benchmarked, and aligned with project scope, schedule, and customer expectations.

What you will bring:

You bring a broad understanding of cost estimating, cost engineering, or related fields, ideally with experience in mechanical, process, or chemical engineering. Familiarity with Topsoe’s proprietary hardware design and technology solutions is highly valued. You are comfortable working with incomplete data and can apply structured, efficient methodologies to deliver high-quality estimates under pressure.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 
Ideally, around 10 years of relevant mechanical/process/cost estimating/cost engineering, or similar

• 
Strong collaboration and networking skills, enabling you to build effective relationships across disciplines

• 
Motivation for knowledge-sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement

• 
The ability to work in a structured, efficient way, manage multiple tasks, and maintain focus under pressure

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English (Danish is advantageous but not required)

• 
Flexibility and openness to improving ways of working and contributing to the ongoing development of estimation tools, methods, and processes

• 
Experience in an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) environment are considered relevant, but not mandatory.

Why join us:

Joining Topsoe means becoming part of a global leader in advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition. You will have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that drive sustainability and energy resiliency worldwide.

We offer:

- A collaborative and inclusive culture where your expertise is valued

- Professional growth supported through learning, mentorship, and career development opportunities

- Empowerment to innovate and contribute to meaningful change

- A healthy work–life balance in a supportive environment

At Topsoe, you will be part of a team that is committed to making a difference and supporting your professional journey.

Your new team:

You will join a team of skilled and professional colleagues who are passionate about delivering high-quality solutions. Our team values open collaboration, shared success, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone’s contributions are recognized and respected.

You will work alongside experts from diverse backgrounds, fostering innovation and excellence in everything we do.

How you can apply:

If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

Application deadline: 03-11-2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying to ensure a fair and unbiased process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

About us:

Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

Drive Commercial Excellence across a global organization and turn strategy into measurable business impact.

At Topsoe, we are accelerating the energy transition through world-leading technologies and solutions. To support our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Global Commercial Excellence who can help transform commercial strategy into measurable business results across our global commercial organization.

This is a unique opportunity for a commercially minded transformation leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, analytics, and change leadership.

The role

You will lead a team of specialists and project managers while working closely with commercial leaders across regions, business units, and functions. Your mission will be to identify and unlock commercial value, improve commercial effectiveness, and ensure that Commercial Excellence initiatives create measurable business impact.

A key priority for the role will be to establish pricing excellence and deliver measurable margin improvement. Beyond pricing, you will help strengthen sales effectiveness, customer impact, and cost-to-serve performance through improved commercial processes, capabilities, tools, and data-driven decision making.

You will act as a catalyst for change, ensuring that new ways of working become embedded and deliver lasting results.

Key responsibilities:

• Lead and develop Topsoe's Commercial Excellence function.

• Partner with commercial leaders to identify value creation opportunities and translate them into actionable initiatives.

• Strengthen the use of commercial data, analytics, CRM, and digital tools to support decision making.

• Monitor business impact and establish clear performance measures for Commercial Excellence activities

The role requires physical presence in Lyngby.

What you bring

You know how to turn commercial ambition into measurable business performance. You’ve led complex transformation—from identifying where value is created to making new ways of working stick.

You bring:

• A track record of delivering commercial transformation and lasting business impact.

• Deep understanding of commercial value drivers, such as pricing, sales effectiveness, customer management and profitability.

• The judgment to connect data, customer insight and business priorities—and focus effort where it will make the greatest difference.

• The influence to align senior leaders and teams across functions, businesses and geographies, even when you don’t have formal authority.

• The leadership to build trust, challenge constructively and create real ownership for change.

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

Direct leadership experience is necessary, however while experience in industrial B2B is advantageous, it is not a requirement. We are interested in what you have delivered and how you have made change endure.

You’re a strategic operator: you see the bigger picture, make complexity actionable and stay close enough to execution to deliver results. You bring commercial rigor and curiosity, and you’re willing to question established practices when there is a better way to create value.

You build momentum by bringing people with you—setting clear direction, earning trust and turning shared priorities into changed behavior. You don’t just launch initiatives; you help embed the capabilities and ways of working that keep improving performance over time.

Why join us

You will be part of the Global Commercial leadership team and have the opportunity to shape how Commercial Excellence contributes to Topsoe's future success. The role offers significant visibility across the organization and the opportunity to influence strategic priorities, commercial performance, and value creation at a global scale.

At Topsoe, we are united by a shared purpose: helping our customers and partners accelerate the energy transition. You will join a company built on innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to solving some of the world's most important challenges.

Your new team

The Commercial Excellence team is part of Global Commercial and consists of dedicated specialists and project managers supporting pricing, sales effectiveness, CRM, commercial processes, tools, and capability development.

The team works closely with commercial leaders across the organization and serves as a catalyst for continuous improvement and commercial performance.

How to apply

If you would like to be part of a global company that combines technology leadership with meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV in English. For questions regarding the position, please contact Lisbet Andersen, phone +45 2646 1509.

Application deadline: October 28, 2026.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

About us

Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

Help Create Structure and Alignment Across Our Supply Chain

Are you passionate about SIOP, data-driven decision-making, and building alignment across the supply chain?

Do you want to play a key role in building and driving our Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process while strengthening the connection between Sales, Production, Procurement, and Logistics?

At Etac, R82, we are looking for a SIOP Process Owner who can help take our planning and decision-making processes to the next level as part of our ambitious growth and transformation journey.

About the role

This is a newly established role that will play a significant part in how we plan, manage, and develop our supply chain going forward.

You will be responsible for establishing and driving our SIOP process, ensuring alignment between demand, inventory, capacity, and supply. At the same time, you will play a key role in transforming data into insights that support better and more proactive decision-making across the organization.

You will work closely with both the organization in Gedved and sales companies across our global Paediatrics business.

Initially, this is a specialist role reporting directly to the Head of Operations. Over time, we expect the function to evolve further and potentially include people management responsibilities.

You will join us at an exciting time as we continue to develop our Operations organization and implement our new ERP platform, M3.

Your key responsibilities

· Establish and continuously develop our SIOP process and ensure an effective planning and decision-making process across the organization

· Drive the monthly planning cycle across Sales, Production, Procurement, and Logistics

· Analyze forecast versus actual demand and translate insights into improvement initiatives and decision support

· Optimize inventory levels and support the balance between service levels and working capital

· Develop KPIs, dashboards, and management reporting

· Prepare scenarios and business impact analyses to support decision-making

· Contribute to the development of our data foundation and digital decision-support tools, including Power BI and future AI-enabled opportunities

· Ensure effective cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder alignment

What we are looking for

You do not need to tick every box from day one, but we imagine that you:

· Have experience within Supply Chain Planning, S&OP/SIOP, Operations, or Supply Chain Analytics

· Have worked with forecasting, inventory management, planning, or similar processes

· Hold a relevant educational background within Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field

· Have strong analytical skills and are comfortable working with large datasets

· Work in a structured manner and have a strong attention to detail

· Are able to translate data into actionable insights and improvements

· Thrive in a cross-functional environment with many stakeholders

· Communicate clearly and build strong relationships

· Are professionally proficient in English, both written and spoken. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement

It is an advantage if you:

· Have experience from an international company and collaborating with sales organizations globally

· Have experience working with ERP systems, preferably M3 or similar

· Have strong Excel skills and preferably experience with Power BI

· Have an interest in digital tools and emerging technologies

· Have experience building new processes, frameworks, or organizational structures

What we offer

We offer a central role with significant influence on the development of our future planning and decision-making processes. You will have the opportunity to build and shape a new function, work closely with the Operations leadership team, and create visible results across the organization.

Your daily work will combine analysis, business development, and operational execution, and you will become part of a highly collaborative environment where ambition, knowledge sharing, and teamwork go hand in hand.

Location: Gedved, Denmark

Questions?

If you would like to learn more about the position, please contact Claus Hjerrild, Head of Operations, Paediatrics EU & RoW, at +45 41 18 47 83.

Interested?

Please submit your CV, including a brief statement of motivation.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

About Etac

Etac is a world-leading developer of innovative assistive devices and patient handling equipment. Since 1973, we have been committed to improving quality of life for the individual, family members and caregivers.

Through our specialised product brands, we offer state-of-the-art solutions for a wide range of daily needs and care settings, for people at all stages of life. Headquartered in Sweden, Etac is a global company with around 1 500 employees, sales in over 80 countries and a revenue of approximately EUR 500 million.

jobs.occupation: IT Specialist - Commercial Retail Applications Support - Gdansk or Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT applications and delivering excellent customer support? Would you like to work with commercial retail solutions that help drive business decisions across multiple markets? Then this Entry IT Specialist role in Arla's Commercial IT organization could be the perfect opportunity for you.

You will join a collaborative and international team that supports critical retail applications used across our business. We are looking for someone eager to learn, grow, and make a difference through great support and service, says IT Delivery Lead, Irma Valantinaite.

About the job

As an IT Specialist for Commercial Retail Applications, you will become part of the Retail Product team within Arla IT. Your primary focus will be supporting Visualfabriq, a key SaaS solution used for promotion planning and trade investment management across Arla markets. You also will contribute to supporting other retail solutions ad hoc.

You will work closely with business users, vendors, super users, and other IT teams to ensure stable operations, efficient support, and continuous improvement of the solution. This role offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in retail planning and Trade Promotion Management while supporting a business-critical SaaS platform used across multiple markets. As we work in Product Teams we are responsible for full life cycle of the application, so you will be involved in all stages of the product from implementation to decommissioning.

Main responsibilities

• Provide second-line support for Visualfabriq users across multiple markets, ensuring stable day-to-day operations.

• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, service requests, and user access issues in a timely manner.

• Manage user administration, including access provisioning, role assignments, and security compliance.

• Support testing and deployment activities for system enhancements, releases, and business-driven changes.

• Monitor application performance and analyze recurring issues to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.

• Collaborate with vendors, business stakeholders, and internal IT teams, while maintaining documentation, knowledge articles, and user training materials.

Who are you?

• You have experience supporting business applications within a retail, commercial, or Trade Promotion Management environment.

• You have a solid understanding of IT Service Management and are familiar with ITIL processes, including incident, problem, and change management.

• You enjoy analyzing issues, identifying root causes, and turning complexity into practical solutions.

• You collaborate effectively with business users, vendors, and IT colleagues in an international environment.

• You take ownership, are eager to learn, and thrive in a role where technology and business processes come together.

Furthermore you are Fluent in English and are able to be present in office 50% of the time.

Nice to have

• Experience with Visualfabriq or similar Trade Promotion Management solutions.

• Experience supporting SaaS applications.

• Experience with user administration, testing, or release activities.

What do we offer?

We offer a dynamic and supportive workplace where learning and development are encouraged. You will work alongside experienced colleagues who are ready to help you grow professionally and personally.

We’re committed to professional development and promoting from within. Our positive and collaborative culture will bring out the best in you. And you’ll join a market leader who produces nutritious household-favourite brands in a way that make things better for our customers, the farmers who own us, and the whole world.

Application and contact

If you are eager to start or continue your IT career within a global organization and contribute to the success of our commercial retail applications, we would love to hear from you.

Please note that this role requires you to be in the office 50% of the time + one additional day (monthly).

We are committed to salary transparency and will discuss the salary range and benefits before the first interview.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

We are looking for a Research Technician with a passion for research and innovation to join the Food Science Laboratory team at Arla Innovation Centre, Aarhus. If you enjoy hands-on laboratory work and have a strong interest in food science and physical analysis, this could be an opportunity for you.

The role will primarily support chemical analyses within the Food Science Laboratory. Candidates with relevant experience in physical analytical methods may have the opportunity to initially support physical analyses before transitioning into a chemistry-focused role. The balance between the two areas will vary over time according to business and project needs, providing an opportunity to develop expertise across multiple analytical disciplines.
